about.title: Reedley Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Reedley's local record shows 38 injury collisions and 53 people hurt in the most recent finalized year, with reports clustering on Wednesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Corridors like Manning Avenue, Dinuba Avenue, I Street, and Reed Avenue carry much of that traffic, and a crash on any of them can leave you dealing with pain, missed work, and an insurance adjuster who calls before you've even seen a doctor. We review what happened, explain your options, and handle communication with insurers while you focus on recovering. There's no fee unless we recover something for you. The sooner evidence from the scene is preserved, the stronger a claim tends to be, so reaching out early matters.

items.title: California's Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident claim in California, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity, like the City of Reedley or Fresno County, is involved. We can help identify which deadline applies before it's missed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so even if you're partly blamed for a Manning Avenue or Dinuba Avenue collision, you may still recover a reduced amount. Our team can help make sure fault percentages are argued fairly rather than accepted at face value.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California places no limit on compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in a car accident case. That makes it worth having someone advocate for the full scope of what you've been through, not just medical bills and lost wages.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use those statements to minimize or dispute a claim later. Our team can advise you on what to say and when.

items.question: Reedley crash reports seem to cluster on Wednesday afternoons — does that affect my claim?
items.answer: The timing of a crash doesn't change your legal rights, but knowing patterns like Wednesday 3-5 p.m. peaks on corridors such as I Street or Reed Avenue can help us gather relevant traffic data, camera footage, or witness accounts tied to that timeframe. Every case still depends on its own facts.

items.question: What does your team actually do for me?
items.answer: We review your car accident claim and help you understand your legal options. Our team handles the legal work, and we typically only get paid if you recover compensation.
